title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
DevOps Engineer

**Location:** Ahmedabad, Gujarat  
**Experience:** 3\+ Years

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **DevOps Engineer** to manage and improve our cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, deployments, and production environments.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage and maintain cloud infrastructure and servers.
* Build and maintain **CI/CD pipelines**.
* Automate deployment and infrastructure processes.
* Monitor system performance, availability, and security.
* Troubleshoot production and deployment issues.
* Work with development teams to improve deployment workflows.
* Manage containers and cloud environments.

Required Skills

* 3\+ years of experience in **DevOps/Cloud Engineering**.
* Strong knowledge of **AWS/Azure/GCP**.
* Experience with **Docker, Kubernetes, Git, and CI/CD**.
* Good knowledge of **Linux** and shell scripting.
* Experience with **Jenkins/GitLab CI/GitHub Actions**.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.

Location

**Ahmedabad, Gujarat**

Pay: ₹648,999\.52 \- ₹1,200,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: DevOPs / Networking Trainee Developer
description:
* + Strong interest in DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, Networking, and IT Infrastructure.
	+ Basic understanding of Linux/Unix operating systems, commands, file systems, processes, and permissions.
	+ Basic understanding of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, ports, firewalls, proxies, and load balancing.
	+ Familiarity with Git and version control systems.
	+ Basic understanding of CI/CD concepts and deployment pipelines.
	+ Exposure to Docker and containerization is a plus.
	+ Basic understanding of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP is a plus.
	+ Exposure to Nginx, Apache, reverse proxies, or API gateways is a plus.
	+ Familiarity with scripting using Python, Bash, or Shell scripting is a plus.
	+ Basic understanding of monitoring, logging, system health, and troubleshooting.
	+ Exposure to tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, or similar is a plus.
	+ Strong analytical, debugging, and problem\-solving skills.
	+ Good communication and collaboration skills.

title: MID DevOps
description:
Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and other DevOps tools  

  



Manage and maintain cloud infrastructure using AWS, Azure, or GCP  

  



Work with Terraform to provision and manage infrastructure as code  

  



Deploy and manage containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes  

  



Automate server configuration and repetitive tasks using Ansible  

  



Monitor servers, applications, and infrastructure and troubleshoot performance or deployment\-related issues  

  



Manage and maintain Linux\-based servers and perform basic system administration tasks  

  



  

  

### **Requirements**

2\.5\+ years of hands\-on experience in DevOps, Cloud, or Infrastructure  

  



Strong knowledge of Jenkins, Git, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and Ansible  

  



Good experience with Linux server administration, Bash/Shell scripting, and troubleshooting  

  



Hands\-on experience with at least one cloud platform: AWS, Azure, or GCP  

  



Good understanding of CI/CD, deployment processes, networking basics, monitoring, and infrastructure security
